summary: Tested the new 'Gerador de Imagens IA' (fal.ai FLUX.1 Schnell) end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (public settings extension, admin PUT, /me/usage extension for both anon & auth, POST /api/generate-image auth/validation, image_gen count isolation vs AI-text 'used', regression on login/qrcode/favorites/history). Frontend: tool page renders with 3 aspect chips (1:1 default selected), Gerar imagem button, UsageBadge 'Você tem 3 usos grátis hoje', visitor Gerar opens auth-required-modal, admin sliders for free/premium image limits present, 503 error 'Geração de imagem não configurada. Adicione FAL_KEY no painel.' surfaced correctly on authed generate. Real fal.ai call not exercised (FAL_KEY empty by design).

ui_bugs.issue: Home slices tools to first 4 (App.js:153 `filtered.slice(0, query?20:4)`). The new 'Gerador de imagens IA' is at index 4 (5th) so it is NOT visible on Home for visitors/logged users, contradicting the acceptance criterion 'aparece na Home logo após Resumir texto na seção Mais usadas'. It is only reachable via /ferramentas or direct URL /ferramenta/image_gen. Recommend changing slice to 5 (or 6) so image_gen shows on Home.

action_items: Bump the Home 'Mais usadas' slice from 4 to 5 (or more) in /app/frontend/src/App.js line 153 so the new image_gen tool actually appears on the Home screen as required.
Configure FAL_KEY via Emergent Secrets Manager to enable real image generation (currently returns 503 as designed).
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/generate-image order: Pydantic validation runs BEFORE the FAL_KEY check (dependency runs after body parsing), so short prompts return 422 while other cases with FAL_KEY empty return 503 before the rate-limit check. This matches the request's documented behavior ('se FAL_KEY vazio, retorna 503 antes de verificar limite'). No fix needed but worth documenting.
Invalid aspect_ratio is silently coerced to 'square_hd' via FAL_ASPECT_MAP.get(..., 'square_hd'). Fine per spec but consider logging/warning for observability.
count_today_image_usage properly filters by tool='image_gen' with BRT day bounds — verified via injected records: image_used=3, 'used' (AI text) stayed 0. Clean isolation.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all data-testids and flows OK; only Home listing miss)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: 3 usage records with tool='image_gen' injected for the isolation test, all cleaned up in the same test. One TEST_ user registered per module (not cleaned; safe prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend generate-image endpoint returns 503 while FAL_KEY is empty — that's expected in preview. If FAL_KEY gets configured, add a paid smoke test that actually calls the endpoint and verifies image_url + record in db.usage. The only functional gap right now is Home tool-list slice(0,4) hiding image_gen; fix once and re-run visitor UI test. Settings were restored to defaults (free=3, premium=50). Admin remains free plan.
